final: WITH g AS (SELECT CENTROMEA AS status, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(`T-BIL` * 1.0 / CRE) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date > '1985-04-22' AND Date < '1994-03-14' GROUP BY CENTROMEA), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM g) SELECT g.status, g.avg_hgb, g.avg_ratio, g.avg_ratio / m.mean_ratio AS ratio_to_mean FROM g, m WHERE m.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL
